title: Add source install rollback checkpoints
summary: The source installer now has a read-only upgrade preflight, but source upgrades still need a restorable checkpoint and verified rollback path before the project can make stronger upgrade-safety claims.
expectedFailureModes: A source reinstall overwrites binaries without preserving restorable prior files.
Rollback restores files without verifying checkpoint digests or prefix boundaries.
Docs imply public package rollback or signed release safety before project signing and package distribution exist.
nextAction: Teach the source installer to preserve replaced files in a bounded checkpoint, add a rollback command and validator, and update distribution docs to distinguish source rollback from public package rollback.
